items.exampleEn: Let me explain why I was late.
items.exampleZh: 讓我解釋一下我為什麼遲到。

items.exampleEn: He has a lot of knowledge about cars.
My uncle is an expert on old coins.
This is an easy method for cooking rice.
The university is next to a big park.
items.exampleZh: 這所大學就在一座大公園旁邊。

items.exampleEn: Write your name and the title on the first page.
items.exampleZh: 在第一頁寫上你的名字和標題。

items.exampleEn: There are three mistakes in this letter.
I'm good at writing but bad at speaking.
items.exampleZh: 我擅長寫作，但不擅長說話。

items.sentenceEn: The teacher explained the problem again.
items.sentenceZh: 老師又把那個問題解釋了一次。

items.audioEn: My brother studies computers at a university in Tainan.
items.audioZh: 我的兄弟在台南的一所大學讀電腦。
items.questionZh: 說話的人的兄弟在哪裡讀大學？

items.sentenceZh: 別擔心，每個人都會犯錯。

items.sentenceEn: Reading gives you knowledge about the world.
items.sentenceZh: 閱讀能讓你了解這個世界。

items.stemEn: Lisa knows everything about birds. She is a bird ____.
items.stemZh: Lisa 對鳥類無所不知，她是鳥類專家。

items.stemEn: Could you ____ how this machine works?
items.stemZh: 你可以說明一下這台機器怎麼運作嗎？

items.passageEn: Ben is a university student. This semester, he has a writing class. At first, his essays had many mistakes. His teacher, an expert in writing, explained a simple method: read your work again slowly before you give it to your teacher. Ben tried it, and now his writing is much better.
items.passageZh: Ben 是大學生。這學期他修了一門寫作課。一開始，他的文章錯誤很多。他的老師是寫作專家，教了他一個簡單的方法：交作業前再慢慢讀一遍。Ben 試了之後，現在他的寫作進步很多。

questions.questionZh: 老師教 Ben 什麼方法？
options: 每天下課後多去圖書館看書
每天晚上睡前寫一篇日記
交作業前再慢慢讀一遍

questions.questionZh: Ben 的寫作後來怎麼樣？

referenceEn: The title of this book is interesting.
This book has an interesting title.
rubricZh: 「書名」可寫例如 title、the title of this book

items.promptZh: 我不小心拿錯了別人的雨傘。
referenceEn: I took someone else's umbrella by mistake.
By mistake, I took another person's umbrella.
rubricZh: 用 by mistake 表示「不小心（弄錯）」，放句首或句尾都可以
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 took、have taken 等）
「別人的」可寫，例如 someone else's、another person's 等
